samples.fresh: Artists with a release in the last 14 days (ListenBrainz fresh releases, single-artist credits), seeded random sample

method.gap: G1: Qloo has no entity (MusicBrainz ID or exact name). G2: Qloo finds the entity but /v2/insights rejects it as a signal.
method.fill: NotOnQ tiers 1–2 (open data + stand-ins), first 30 gap artists, no research agent
method.backtest: Artists Qloo does know: Qloo's own top-20 'fans also like' vs the answer from up to 5 stand-ins (the artist itself hidden), first 15 with enough stand-ins
